name: Littlestone Dimension of Universal Class
proof: Let d be $\lfloor\log_2 n\rfloor$ and select $2^d$ indices. Assign them distinct d-bit strings; at level t query the domain point consisting of the selected indices whose tth bit is one. Every root-to-leaf label sequence is realized by its coded $u_i$, so $\mathrm L\geq d$. A depth-d mistake tree has $2^d$ distinct realized leaves, whereas the class has n hypotheses, proving the matching upper bound.
